scope.summary: Implement biophysical tone parameters (spec 13.22; PREQ-004): melanin/hemoglobin/specular utility maps from which albedo is DERIVED - tone changes re-derive the albedo rather than RGB-tinting it - with the hemoglobin map doubling as the flush/engorgement target for the arousal controller (MT-559).
acceptance_criteria: Utility map set (melanin, hemoglobin, specular) stored per body; albedo derives from biophysical parameters plus maps, and tone changes re-derive albedo - never a tint pass (PREQ-004).
Tone sweep: the melanin parameter range from pale to very dark produces a plausible deterministic albedo series (golden-hash pinned).
The hemoglobin map is addressable as the flush/engorgement driver target consumed by the MT-559 arousal controller via an explicit link.
Derived albedo feeds the layer stack as its base layer; re-derivation invalidates downstream bakes through the hash chain.
scope.risk_if_missed: RGB-tinting albedo for tone changes produces the grey/ashy dark skin every character-tool ecosystem complains about; without melanin/hemoglobin derivation, dark-tone bodies and the arousal flush target have no principled color path (PREQ-004) and the MT-558 all-tones genital blend has nothing sound to blend against.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
